validated_results.title: Endogenously formed N-nitroso compounds and nitrosating agents in human cancer etiology.
validated_results.reason: This is a narrative review of endogenous N-nitroso compound formation and nitrosating agents in cancer etiology, not an original human study of nitric oxide intake and incident bladder cancer.
